title: VUA download event v0.1
description: One normalized transport event reported by the F4 download port to AMF (docs/protocols/download-events-v0.1). The port reports transport facts only: content identity, inspection verdicts, source correlation and Warehouse decisions are AMF's. Events never carry cookies, download tokens or credentials, and storedPath is the only path field.

downloadId.description: Port-assigned identity, stable across retry attempts and resume() continuations of the same DownloadItem.

attempt.description: 1-based port counter; unchanged across an interrupted/resume continuation, incremented on a fresh retry attempt.

initiatedFromPageUrl.description: Page context captured at will-download time; correlation input for AMF source mapping.

urlChain.description: Redirect chain captured at will-download time (getURLChain); source-verification input, never a path or credential carrier.

suggestedFileName.description: Server-suggested or derived file name; never parsed for identity by AMF.

storedPath.description: The ONLY path field: final name inside the VUA-managed staging directory, reported verbatim. Absent when no file was created (policy rejection at will-download).

expectedBytes.description: Content-Length when the server sent one; unknown size is null, never inflated to 0.

resumable.description: The port's resumability verdict (Electron canResume()); the port never self-observes range headers as a second signal.

failureKind.description: Failure attribution, failed events only: policy is the port's own self-attributable allowlist denial at will-download; everything else is unknown — the port cannot honestly distinguish network, disk or server causes on the Electron event surface.
